start.title: Hijos de Adán
start.text:
Abres los ojos como el primogénito de Adán y Eva.
Un segundo hijo, Abel, nace después de ti.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: Tu trabajo
fields.text:
Pasan los años. Cada hermano encuentra su labor.
¿Cuál es la tuya?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: El trabajo de tu hermano
abel_pasture.text:
Ves a Abel al otro lado del campo.
¿Qué está haciendo?

choices.text: [TODO:es] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:es] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:es] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: Ante el altar
offerings.text:
Llega el momento de llevar una ofrenda al Señor.
¿Qué llevarás?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: La mirada del Señor
accepted.text:
Esperas mientras el Señor mira las dos ofrendas.
¿Qué sucede?

choices.text: [TODO:es] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:es] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:es] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: Tu rostro decae
anger.text:
La ofrenda ha terminado. Algo surge en ti.
¿Cómo respondes?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: El pecado acechando a la puerta
warning.text:
El Señor te habla.
¿Qué te dice?

choices.text: [TODO:es] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: Hablas con tu hermano
invitation.text:
Abel se acerca, confiado.
¿Qué le dices?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:es] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: En el campo
field.text:
Tú y Abel estáis solos en el campo abierto.
¿Qué haces?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: ¿Dónde está tu hermano?
confrontation.text:
La voz del Señor te encuentra.
«¿Dónde está tu hermano Abel?»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:es] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: Un vagabundo inquieto
wanderer.text:
El Señor te pone una marca para tu protección.
Sales a vagar al este del Edén, en la tierra de Nod.
